scoring_justification: Effective Helmholtz energies are the result of numerical minimization; recomputing them from raw artifacts would require re-running the same minimization. Instead we verify structural properties: energy ordering, constancy of Voigt/Taylor and Reuss/Sachs, and minima location of the partial rank‑one model.

theta.description: Polar angle of interface normal vector N

phi.description: Azimuthal angle of interface normal vector N

energy_VoigtTaylor.description: Fully relaxed Helmholtz energy for Voigt/Taylor model

energy_ReussSachs.description: Fully relaxed Helmholtz energy for Reuss/Sachs model

energy_PartialRankOne.description: Fully relaxed Helmholtz energy for partial rank-one convexification model

outputs.description: CSV file containing the fully relaxed Helmholtz energies for the three homogenization models as a function of interface orientation. Used to verify energy ordering (Voigt/Taylor >= partial rank-one >= Reuss/Sachs), constancy of Voigt/Taylor and Reuss/Sachs energies, and that minima of the partial rank-one model occur at coherent orientations.

output_contract.notes: The checker will verify structural properties of the submitted CSV without comparing to absolute hidden gold values. The task only requires the planar interface RVE analysis; the 1D example and spherical inclusion FEM are excluded as noted in the plan.
